description.value: A family-owned estate winery nestled in the Creston Valley of the Kootenays, Baillie-Grohman grows cool-climate varieties including Pinot Noir, Pinot Gris, and Gewürztraminer on its own vineyard. The tasting room pairs wine flights with a food menu of local charcuterie boards, warm brie, and seasonal accompaniments sourced from valley producers. Summer evenings bring live music and Sunday DJ sessions in the outdoor pavilion, making this a lively destination stop for cyclists exploring the Kootenay wine route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides clear contact details, a food menu, wine tasting room, and event programming. OSM has no address or phone, so those contact fields cannot be cross-checked against OSM values — they are taken from the website as the primary source. No bike-specific amenities (parking, pump, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those are null; the menu page explicitly notes gluten-free crackers available on request, confirming a GF option.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone number — both taken from website only and could not be cross-checked against OSM.
Bike parking, washrooms, and water refill availability are not mentioned anywhere on the website; these required criteria remain unverified and will need on-the-ground or direct-contact confirmation.
Events page notes 'we are an outdoor venue' for workshops, suggesting limited indoor shelter; relevant for weather-exposed cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operating estate winery with a tasting room and food service in the Creston Valley — a well-known cycling corridor in the Kootenays. Bike-specific amenities are unconfirmed but the venue is a clear destination-stop candidate for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu states 'Gluten free crackers are available upon request' and notes staff accommodate allergies and dietary requirements. The Forager board (hummus, tapenade, vegetables, fruit, focaccia) is a vegetarian option
